what: Pre-registered observations for the signed-RUN reproduction packet (collective issue #21). v2's were written and committed before any run of v2. v2.4's changes (C1 refused at the new pin; case 10_planted_json; variant no_isolation; no second read expected in C1 under extra_parent_read) were written and committed before any run of v2.4; the gist's history shows the order. v1 (../packet/) is kept as it was; v2 answers ChatGPT's review of v1 (../review/).

observations.outcome: What happened, from execution evidence only. RAN_APPROVED / RAN_CHANGED / RAN_SUBSTITUTE: exactly that script's marker file exists with the right content, after at least one launch attempt. NOTHING: no marker and no launch attempt. LAUNCH_NO_MARKER: a launch was attempted and no marker exists. INCONCLUSIVE: the fixture did not do its part (the harness raised, more than one marker, a marker with the wrong content, or in case 5 a launch with no swap confirmed before it).
observations.reads: How many times the parent process (the worker) opened workshop/probe.py while the door handled the request, counted by an audit hook on 'open'. The harness's own setup and its swaps are not counted: they happen outside that window, or write a temporary file and rename it over probe.py.
observations.child_args: For a launch: the arguments the child process was given after the script name, read from the launch call itself (audit event subprocess.Popen).
observations.planted_loaded: Case 10 only (v2.4): whether workshop/ran_planted.txt exists after the case, i.e. whether the launched child imported the planted workshop/json.py.

cases.1_signed_no_args: probe.py = APPROVED; body {run_sha256: sha256(APPROVED)} signed by the registered throwaway key; caller 127.0.0.1; answer 'HANDS RUN probe.py'.
cases.2_changed_bytes: as 1, but probe.py = CHANGED (a different script).
cases.2b_one_byte_added: as 1, but probe.py = APPROVED plus one trailing newline (a one-byte difference that would still run the approved marker).
cases.3_added_args: as 1, but the answer is 'HANDS RUN probe.py --extra 1'.
cases.3b_one_argument: as 1, but the answer is 'HANDS RUN probe.py x'.
cases.4_unsigned_loopback: as 1, but no signature headers; caller address set explicitly to 127.0.0.1.
cases.5a_swap_at_launch: as 1; when the hands call subprocess.run to start the child (after the hash check and the screen), the harness replaces probe.py with SUBSTITUTE, confirms it, then lets the launch go ahead.
cases.5b_swap_continuous: as 1; when the gate is asked (after the single read, before the hash check) a thread starts replacing probe.py with SUBSTITUTE, the gate waits until the first replacement is confirmed, and the thread keeps replacing it until the act returns.
cases.6_body_changed_after_signing: the signature headers are made for the body {run_sha256: sha256(CHANGED)}, but the body sent is {run_sha256: sha256(APPROVED)}, which matches probe.py = APPROVED.
cases.7_bad_signature_registered_key: as 1, but X-Operator-Signature is a real signature by the registered key over a different body.
cases.8_unregistered_key: as 1, but signed (validly) by a second throwaway key that is not registered anywhere.
cases.9_signed_without_hash: probe.py = APPROVED; the signed body is {text: 'please run it'}, with no run_sha256.
cases.10_planted_json: v2.4 (capitaharlock, HF 191990 #2). probe.py = IMPORTS_JSON (imports json, then writes the approved marker); beside it, workshop/json.py = PLANTED_JSON, which writes ran_planted.txt if imported. The signed body carries sha256(IMPORTS_JSON). The child is launched with -I, so its working directory (the workshop) is not on sys.path and the planted file should not load.
cases.C1_ally_key_default_scope: CHARACTERIZATION, not part of the posted claim. As 1, but signed by a third throwaway key that is not an operator signer and IS registered as an ally (covenant_mycelium.register_ally, default scope, which includes /m/agent). At v2.3's pin (9d85f6c) it was pre-registered from reading the source as running, and ran. At v2.4's pin the door's may_run accepts only one of the operator's own signers (A447), so it is pre-registered as refused: nothing launched.

pinned.what: the nine files exactly as at the pinned commit (git blob hashes checked).

no_signature_check.what: the door treats every request as signed (_may_run = True).

no_args_check.what: the A436 argument refusal never fires.

child_reopens.what: the child opens probe.py by name instead of reading the parent's bytes from standard input (the runner before A430).

extra_parent_read.what: run() opens probe.py once more and discards what it read (just before the screen). Behaviour is unchanged; only the read count can show it.

no_body_digest.what: the signed message stops covering the body (operator_signing_payload hashes an empty body whatever was sent).

no_registry_check.what: verify_signed admits a key that is not a registered signer.

no_isolation.what: v2.4, capitaharlock's control: the hands launch the child without -I, so the workshop (its working directory) is on sys.path and the planted json.py is imported.

rule: Each variant's expected observations are the pinned ones with its overrides applied (an override replaces only the fields it names). A variant meets its pre-registration when every case's observed outcome is one of the listed outcomes, its read count equals 'reads', where 'child_args' is given and a launch happened the child's arguments equal it, and where 'planted_loaded' is given it matches. Exit 0 only when all twelve variants meet theirs and nothing was INCONCLUSIVE; exit 3 when anything was INCONCLUSIVE; exit 1 when an observation differs; exit 2 when it could not run.
